title: Crimson Moon Enchantress
description: A surreal composite scene featuring a large portrait of a blonde woman with curly hair in the upper left, a woman in a long black ornate dress standing with her back to the viewer beside a white cat, both silhouetted against a massive glowing red moon. The foreground contains vibrant pink cosmos flowers, a blue and red plaid fabric, while the background shows a ruined cityscape under a colorful nebula-filled sky.
